title: Common dominating compact-finite measure for two finite families of compact-finite measures
statement: Let X be a topological space equipped with a σ-algebra; no compatibility between the two is assumed. Let m ∈ ℕ and let a, b : Fin m → Measure X be two families of measures on X, each of which is finite on compact sets. Then there is a measure μ₀ on X that is finite on compact sets and satisfies aᵢ ≪ μ₀ and bᵢ ≪ μ₀ for every i ∈ Fin m.
lean_statement: ∀ (X : Type) [TopologicalSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] (m : ℕ) (a b : Fin m → Measure X), (∀ i, IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts (a i)) → (∀ i, IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts (b i)) → ∃ μ₀ : Measure X, IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ₀ ∧ (∀ i, a i ≪ μ₀) ∧ ∀ i, b i ≪ μ₀
